simple.meaning: רִמֹּן פֶּרֶץ (Rimmôn Perets) is a Hebrew word meaning “Rimmon-Perets , a place in the Desert.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: רִמֹּן פֶּרֶץ (H7428) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 33:19, with occurrences in Numbers.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to רִמֹּן פֶּרֶץ (H7428) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in רִמֹּן פֶּרֶץ (H7428) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: רִמֹּן פֶּרֶץ (Rimmôn Perets) / H7428 is traced through Numbers 33:19, Numbers 33:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
